$comment: Relation-layer conformance scenarios (srs#180). Each scenario cites the recorded rule it checks; a scenario with no recorded rule is not here (see README). `steps` run in order against a fresh copy of fixture-repo with the pinned srs CLI: `cli` arguments without --repo, `stdin` an optional JSON body, `expect` on the envelope (`ok`, `errorCode` = errors[0].code, `diagnosticIncludes` = a substring of the diagnostics). `afterValidate` lists what `repo validate` must then report (`errors` count and each expected warning as a message substring). A scenario with `pending` is not run: the pinned build does not emit the rule's diagnostic and `pending.issue` names the srs-rust issue.

scenarios.description: A relation whose target resolves to no instance is refused on write (E2UnknownEndpoint).
A relation whose source resolves to no instance is refused on write (E2UnknownEndpoint).
A relation whose type resolves to no installed relation type is refused on write (E1UnknownRelationType).
A containerId is not an instance id: a relation targeting it is refused (the container id resolves to no instance, E2UnknownEndpoint).
A containerId is not an instance id: a relation sourced from it is refused (E2UnknownEndpoint).

A transition into a state declaring a hard requiresRelation is refused while no satisfying relation exists, with the machine-readable code lifecycle-relation-required naming the state, the type and the direction.

expect.diagnosticIncludes: state 'superseded' requires a satisfying 'incoming' relation of type ["supersedes"]

scenarios.description: The same transition is allowed once a satisfying incoming supersedes relation exists, and the repository then validates with the baseline warning only.

A transition into an advisory state is permitted without the relation; the unsatisfied state surfaces only as a warning at rest (lifecycle-advisory-relation-unsatisfied), never an error. Gamma is moved there; the fixture's Beta already rests there.

scenarios.rule: I-88 (the sourceRole value set is a closed enum of the implemented revision, RFC-023)
scenarios.description: A SourceReference whose sourceRole is a relation-type key (depends-on) is refused: the two vocabularies are disjoint.
Relation-type creation MUST reject a definition whose key equals a sourceRole value, and repo validate MUST report a pre-existing collision as SOURCEROLE_RELATIONTYPE_COLLISION (warning at rest).
